relationships.evidence: DatabasePackedFile.mpResourceMan is at +0x380; database vtable exposes Attach/CloseRecord and manager registration path.
Directory database stores extension map, ResourceKey-to-record map, default group, resource-manager back-pointer, and filename converter.
Current DBPF rows are type/group/instance plus offset/size/compression; original key carries the same three IDs.
Factory map at +0x30, resource-to-record map at +0x54, record-to-resource map at +0x78, and vtable slots FindFactory/RegisterFactory.
Create scans DAT_016b44f0 for matching instanceID and serializer, then stores an intrusive resource pointer; mCounter is incremented by the resolver.
FUN_00e822c0 clears/release existing pointer, calls FUN_00e821d0 for a new resource, and reports a typed load error on failure.
GetModelKeyForCellResource scans cell-resource entries and returns a ResourceKey from fixed defaults, a map-backed helper, or current CellGame state.
PreloadCellResource/AddPreloadedModel and cCellGFX.mPreloadedModels vector establish the static preload producer/consumer path.
PreloadPopulateResource dispatches marker kinds to cell preload, nested populate preload, or indexed cell-resource variants.
cCellGFX::Initialize creates world/layer handles; OnEnter calls StartDisplay, which enables world/shadow/lighting state.
CreateCellObject writes model/resource fields and creates a cell object in the 4096-entry pool; current OpenSpore mirrors a typed subset.
PlayAnimation writes current animation/blend state; InstanceEffectOnCell binds effect placement to the cell transform; movement writes target/orientation state.

01_construct.operation: Initialize vtable/container state for manager-owned maps, lists, mutexes, and cache/factory slots.

02_initialize.operation: Build/rebuild a modulo-bucket hash/index structure; helper FUN_008DED00 inserts and can trigger rehash.

03_register_databases.operation: Register DatabasePackedFile and DatabaseDirectoryFiles sources in manager database state.

04_register_factories.operation: Associate resource types with IResourceFactory objects and supported type sets.

05_key_lookup.operation: Resolve ResourceKey identity through registered database/factory state; the shared loader first calls FUN_008DE9D0 and then dispatches factory/read paths.

06_load_and_cache.operation: Use existing lookup when available; otherwise dispatch factory read/create, populate the typed object, and hand off to cache/release paths.

07_cache_query.operation: Query, retain, and flush loaded resource state. mCacheVector is at cResourceManager+0x9C; exact eviction and ownership are not fully recovered.

08_dispose.operation: Release manager-owned cache, factory, notification, mapping, and database state.

01_mode_initialize.operation: Allocate/establish sCellGame, sCellGFX, sCellUI and initialize mode state.

02_cell_data_refs.operation: Create central CellDataReference entries from the CellGame/ namespace/key table and obtain globals.

03_gfx_initialize.operation: Create world/layer/shadow/lighting handles, including CellGame-Main and CellGame-Background.

04_preload.operation: Walk central cell and populate references, recursively preload cell dependencies, effects, textures, and creatures.

05_game_initialize.operation: Initialize 4096-cell pool, current world/background references, timing, collectable state, and service hooks.

06_enter.operation: Reset mode/UI flags, call cCellGFX::StartDisplay, and activate gameplay/presentation services.

07_update_and_gameplay.operation: Per-frame Cell update, movement target/orientation/moving writes, pool/query/gameplay use.

08_effect_and_animation.operation: Bind effects to cell transform and update animation target/current state for gameplay events.

09_exit_dispose.operation: Restore globals, release gameplay/presentation state, and free Cell singleton objects.

contradictions.issue: SDK anchors for DatabasePackedFile::Lock and PFIndexModifiable::Read do not equal live Ghidra function entries.
contradictions.details: SDK labels are 0x008D84F0 and 0x008DBCC0; live entries are 0x008D84D0 and 0x008DBC20.
contradictions.resolution: Keep both values, mark the SDK value as an anchor and the live value as the function entry; do not silently collapse them.

contradictions.issue: Some cResourceManager vtable slot entries are wrappers or earlier bodies while SDK-named bodies are at different addresses.
contradictions.details: GetPrivateResource vtable entry is 0x008DF940 while the SDK-named body is 0x008DFC10; GetRecordKeyList2 vtable entry is 0x008E0C10 while the SDK-named body is 0x008E0EE0; GetTypenameFromType vtable entry is 0x008DFC60 while the SDK-named body is 0x008DFF30.
contradictions.resolution: Treat the vtable layout and SDK body addresses as separate evidence; use the exact symbol/address pair in function records.

contradictions.issue: The address 0x00E82340 has historically been labeled cCellDataReference_::Create, but the SDK-associated function is 0x00E82420.
contradictions.resolution: Keep 0x00E82340 as FUN_00E82340 and 0x00E82420 as SDK-associated cCellDataReference_::Create; relationship remains unresolved.

contradictions.issue: The older recon appendix calls DBPF v3 layout UNKNOWN, while later committed C++/oracle work verifies the 32-bit DBPF v3 header/index/extent path.
